experiment: Dense phrase position slots and sorted intersection
status: 100k CPU experiment; not a 2M latency gate

implementation.baseline: Native AEAD, bounded gzip allocation hint, synchronous bounded ranking-page cache hits; phrase starts use per-component document maps and sets.
implementation.candidate: Per-component 1024-document slot arrays retain sorted visitor-owned position lists; expansion lists merge with sorted union; phrase offsets intersect with monotonic cursors.
properties: Visitor-owned position lists are retained without mutation.
Position decoding and validation, canonical fallback, scoring and ordering remain unchanged.
No new permanent cache, storage format, schema or public API.

fixture.origin: Existing exclusive private copy of the completed managed-codec audit fixture; no live producer database access.

provenance.compilation: AOT native-asset bundles; depfiles confirm private implementation imports and sodium 4.0.4.

method.queries: Broad terms and phrases, names, fuzzy matches, prefix/suffix edges and repeated words, each unfiltered and restricted to group:email.
method.instrumentation: /proc/self/stat CPU ticks and faults, /proc/self/io deltas around each query; 100 clock ticks per second.
method.memoryComparison: Four separate single-worker runs in baseline,dense,dense,baseline order.

correctness.countClarification: The 690 full-experiment checks also include 230 checks from an excluded private control; dense claims use its 230 exact baseline-ordered results.
correctness.privateTests: Both candidate ranking suites plus editorial relevance and posting validation; added canonical top 100 checks on long repeated transcripts, repeated components, expansion unions, fuzzy and unsupported numeric/short boundaries.

review.productionDifferenceFromBenchmarkedCandi: Only braces added around the merged-position duplicate guard; no behavioral difference.
review.correctness: Sorted union preserves expansion OR semantics. Component offsets are applied during monotonic intersection; shared repeated-component lists are never modified. Unsupported phrase boundaries retain canonical fallback and posting validation.

limits: Generated 100k fixture on a shared host; does not establish the 500 ms p95 goal at 2M documents.
CPU tick measurements are quantized to 10 ms; aggregate differences are more reliable than individual queries.
Warm physical read bytes and major faults were zero; this measures cached CPU behavior.
Peak-memory reduction is modest; process RSS and systemd accounting differ.
